thread:
sasha: Heads-up — planning sprint tradeoffs for the next HW booking window. Need to pick priorities between H200 prebuys, L40S short-term fill, and APAC bandwidth constraints.
marc: +1. Can you sketch the SKU mix you're considering?\s
anya: we should also factor in rack power limits for H200 — might reduce usable density in eu-west.
marc: rough idea: option A: 60% H200, 30% L40S, 10% H100 as fallback. option B: 40% H200, 50% L40S, 10% H100 (cheaper, faster leadtime).
jon: what are lead times right now? last I saw H200 was 16–20 weeks, L40S 4–8?
infra-bot: procurement update: H200 vendor quoted 18 weeks from PO; L40S availability in NA/EU ~6 weeks; APAC lead time adds ~3–4w logistics.
david: if we push heavier on L40S we can hit Q2 surge but throughput per-GPU will be lower for some workloads. need GPU_hours calc for each plan.
anya: agree — can we approximate token throughput differences? L40S ~0.6x H200 on large seq jobs, H100 ~0.9x for some models with mixed precision.
sasha: quick calc I did in prod channel:
```
# conservative throughput per GPU (tokens/s)
H200=850
H100=760
L40S=500
# projected Q2 token demand: 1.2e9 tokens/day
```
marc: from that, GPU_hours/day = tokens/day / (tokens/s * 3600). for option A vs B we need to multiply by fractions.
jon: can you run numbers and post? would help with cost delta.
sasha: ran them quickly:
Option A (60% H200, 30% L40S, 10% H100): ~3,900 GPU-hours/day
Option B (40% H200, 50% L40S, 10% H100): ~4,600 GPU-hours/day
Margins: Option B adds ~18% more hours (so ~18% higher infra cost) but reduces leadtime risk.
david: OK that 18% is nontrivial. But if L40S allows earlier capacity we might save on latency-related churn. Also check preemption/fallback cost if APAC is delayed.
elaine: APAC is our big region risk — we only have limited rack space in apac-e and networking egress burst costs there spike with more nodes. if we go heavy on L40S in APAC we'll pay more egress.
marc: what about hybrid routing — put short-tail low-latency traffic on H200 in eu/na, route APAC traffic to L40S local pools to avoid egress?
anya: that works but requires extra routing rules and some canary rollout. ops effort estimate: ~2 engineers for 3 sprints to implement and test.
jon: ops cost might be cheaper than 18% recurring GPU spend. need a TCO calc (infra hours + eng hours + logistics risk).
sasha: flagged for finance sync. Also propose a staggered PO: commit 30% H200 now (to lock price), hold rest contingent on vendor ETA/market signals.
infra-bot: procurement action created: PO-draft-#4827 (30% H200), assigned to @marc, due 2024-05-02.
marc: I can take the PO-draft. question: does 30% commit still keep us eligible for better pricing tiers?
sasha: vendor said tiering kicks in at 50% commit; we lose some discount with only 30% but we buy flex. tradeoff: price vs optionality.
david: another axis: quantify model mix impact. some customers run short-chat workloads (high qps low seq) where L40S is cost-effective; long-seq fine-tuning customers prefer H200. can we shadow traffic to estimate?
anya: yes — propose 2-week shadow runs routing 15% of long-seq traffic to L40S to measure degradation and cost per request.
jon: timeline? we need numbers before final PO.
sasha: target: start shadow next Mon, collect 2 weeks, present numbers at sprint planning on 2024-05-20.
elaine: reminder: ensure power/cooling checks for any H200 racks we provision. Ops will schedule a datacenter walk for eu-west next Tue.
marc: noted. I'll update the procurement doc with stagger plan and ask vendor for early partial shipment options.
sasha: thanks everyone. if no objections I'll run with the 30% commit + shadowing plan. :thumbsup:
jon: +1
david: +1
anya: +1
infra-bot: status update will be posted to #procurement-daily at 09:00 UTC starting tomorrow.
